content.thinking: Check /mnt/ai-models on halo150 — it may be an NFS mount with different permissions or not mounted at all. The CT150 config needs an NFS mount entry since it was previously using a different data path.

arguments.command: printf '\n=== halo150: CHECK /mnt/ai-models ===\n'; ssh -i ~/.ssh/thin-mint root@10.0.1.110 'pct exec 150 -- bash -c "ls -la /mnt/ 2>&1; ls -la /mnt/ai-models 2>&1 || echo NOT_MOUNTED; touch /mnt/ai-models/test-write 2>&1 && rm /mnt/ai-models/test-write && echo WRITABLE || echo NOT_WRITABLE; df -h /mnt/ai-models 2>&1"' 2>&1
